## Research Experience

**Visiting Researcher**, Universitätsklinikum Hamburg-Eppendorf, Department of Medical Psychology, Hamburg, Germany *(March 2023 – January 2024)*

- Conducted an independent project on perceptions of and attitudes toward mental health care services among refugees and asylum seekers, supervised by Dr. Mike-Oliver Mösko, head of the Migration and Psychosocial Health research group
- Developed an interview guide and participated in data analysis for a study on multilingualism and the mental health of migrants
- Translated educational materials on mental health services for Vietnamese migrants across the European Union

**Social Science Research Professional 1**, Stanford School of Medicine, Department of Surgery, Palo Alto, CA *(March 2022 – February 2023)*

- Conducted surgical health policy, services, and outcomes research at the Stanford-Surgery Policy Improvement Research & Education (S-SPIRE) Center
- Enrolled and coached patients through a prehabilitation study; studied the correlation between frailty and adherence to prehabilitation among colorectal surgery patients
- Managed and analyzed clinical trial data, and summarized and presented findings to research professionals in various settings

**Research Assistant**, UCI Department of Family Medicine, Irvine, CA *(May 2020 – March 2022)*

- Investigated the impact of COVID-19 on family physicians' mental health using mixed methods; surveyed and interviewed family physicians
- Trained 14 undergraduate and medical students in semi-structured interviewing and prepared an interview protocol and script
- Presented at the American Public Health Association (APHA) and American Academy of Family Physicians (AAFP) conferences; published a qualitative article in *Qualitative Research in Medicine & Healthcare*

**Undergraduate Researcher**, UCI Department of Population Health and Disease Prevention, Irvine, CA *(July 2020 – June 2021)*

- Conducted an independent spatial epidemiology project, "Assessing the Effect of Exposure to Perfluoroalkyl Substances on Ovarian Cancer Survival," using more than 11,700 patient records from the California Cancer Registry to estimate the odds of ovarian cancer survival given PFAS exposure
- Presented at the Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program Symposium and the Public Health Honors Symposium
- Received the Excellence in Writing award for the best written thesis and oral presentation

**Research Assistant**, Cellular & Molecular Immunology Laboratory, Irvine, CA *(July 2018 – September 2020)*

- Collaborated on development of a human herpes simplex virus vaccine and a pan-coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 vaccine using molecular biology techniques
- Evaluated candidate vaccines and immunotherapeutic molecules against cancers
- Trained new undergraduates in lab maintenance and experimental techniques (immunohistochemistry, PCR, Western blotting, ELISA, flow cytometry)
- Co-authored three publications in *The Journal of Immunology*, *Journal of Virology*, and *Frontiers in Immunology*

**President**, Healing Through Humanities at UCI, UC Irvine *(September 2017 – June 2021)*
